findings.title: unsubscribe action does not check current_user presence
findings.body: The `unsubscribe` action calls `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, ...)` without checking that `current_user` is present. While `ensure_logged_in` before_filter is applied, the find_by can return nil if a TopicUser record doesn't exist yet (e.g. a user who has never visited the topic), causing a NoMethodError on `tu.notification_level` for nil. This will 500 for users unsubscribing from topics they haven't interacted with before (no existing topic_user row), which is a plausible scenario when clicking an unsubscribe link in a digest/mailing email.

findings.title: unsubscribe action lacks ownership verification of topic_user record
findings.body: The code fetches `TopicUser` by `user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id]` which is fine for ownership, but there's no `guardian.ensure_can_see!` check as in `show`. A logged-in user could unsubscribe from a topic they otherwise could not see (information disclosure via side channel is minor, but behavior is inconsistent with `show`'s access control).

findings.title: Duplicate respond_instructions placeholder emitted twice
findings.body: The template outputs `%{respond_instructions}` twice (once inside the context_posts block at line 6, and unconditionally again at line 19). Since `html_part` in message_builder.rb does a global `gsub!` for `%{respond_instructions}`, both placeholders get replaced with the same text, resulting in duplicated response instructions in the rendered email when context_posts are present. This existed before but combined with the new unsubscribe_url change, it's worth flagging since the diff touches this file extensively without fixing the duplication issue.

findings.title: unsubscribe_url not guaranteed present in template_args when rendering unsubscribe_link i18n string
findings.body: The new `unsubscribe_link` i18n string references `%{unsubscribe_url}` (per server.en.yml diff), but `MessageBuilder#html_part`/`#body` call `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` unconditionally when `add_unsubscribe_link` is true. If `unsubscribe_url` is not passed in `@opts` (e.g. digest emails, which still just use `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without `unsubscribe_url`), I18n translation will raise a missing interpolation argument error, since digest doesn't set `unsubscribe_url`. This breaks the digest email flow since `digest` method in user_notifications.rb was not updated to pass `unsubscribe_url`.
